author: SpeakerJohnson
text:
A Marine and WWII hero, Woody Williams was the last surviving Medal of Honor recipient from WWII. The Hershel “Woody” Williams National Medal of Honor Monument Location Act will honor his legacy and the courage and sacrifice of all who have earned our nation’s highest military honor on the National Mall.

Honored to join @JimJustice_WV, @RepBlakeMoore, and heroic Medal of Honor recipients as @POTUS signed this historic bill into law. 🇺🇸
